title: Quiz: Arrays and Lists
description: Check your understanding of Arrays and Lists.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in C?
questions.explanation: In C, // marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: In most languages, the first element of a list has index...
questions.explanation: Zero-based indexing is the near-universal convention.

questions.question: True or False: Lists can store values of mixed types in dynamically typed languages.
Fill in the blank: items[${i}]  // get element at position i
questions.explanation: Access uses numeric positions starting at 0.

questions.question: In C, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
